hero.role: Software Engineer | Backend & Systems Architecture | Full-Stack, Mobile & AI-Assisted Development
hero.intro: I build backend systems and business software for companies with real operational complexity — multi-step workflows, multiple user roles, payments that need to reconcile correctly. Full-stack, mobile, security, and AI-assisted delivery are all part of the toolkit; backend and architecture are where I go deep.

summary.title: About Me
summary.lede: 2+ years building production software — full-stack, mobile, security, and AI — for businesses with real operational complexity.

cards.title: Full-Stack Development
cards.description: End-to-end web applications with React, Next.js, Node.js, and PostgreSQL — architected for real business workflows, not just CRUD screens, from database to deployment.

cards.title: Mobile Development
cards.description: Cross-platform apps with React Native and Flutter that work as an operational tool for a business, not just a customer-facing extra — built for performance and native-like UX.

cards.title: Application Security
cards.description: Penetration testing, OWASP assessments, and secure SDLC integration from design through production.

cards.title: Cloud Technologies
cards.description: AWS, Vercel, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines — infrastructure that stays reliable as a business's usage and complexity grow, not just at launch.

cards.title: AI-Assisted Development
cards.description: OpenAI APIs, Claude, and AI workflow automation built into the actual delivery pipeline — used to design and ship business systems faster.
